name: Chikan Otori Sousa
source:
My boyfriend was falsely accused of being a molester.
To clear his name I put myself on the same train
to root out the true culprit. I never thought I would feel...
like that... but when I felt the touch, I lost myself... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102062.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的男友被誣陷為痴漢。為了洗清他的嫌疑，我登上同一列電車，試圖找出真正的犯人。我從沒想過自己會有那種感覺……可當身體被觸碰時，我徹底失去了自我……

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102062.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
